data_safety_draft.network_access: The app requests public AllSky Manciano images, weather projection, archive/meteor catalogue pages and the sky-map page over HTTPS. The developer directly manages the AllSky host and confirms access logs are retained for six months for technical operation and security. Requests necessarily expose the connection IP and technical request data to that host. No account, user-submitted content, analytics, advertising, or IP-based location inference is implemented. Map the IP/log handling to the current Play Data safety data types and purposes when the account is cleared to create the app; do not claim that no data is collected.
